caption: The video depicts a grassy backyard where a low fire pit built from stacked concrete blocks holds a small open flame. A thick white smoke plume rises and drifts continuously above the burning material. A heap of leafy branches lies beside the pit on the left, while a two-story house, orange safety fencing, and a sloped lawn fill the background. At the left edge of the frame, a person in a dark shirt and light shorts stands with only part of their body visible, their arm shifting slightly as the fire flickers. The person then steps further into view and bends forward over the branch pile beside the burning pit, a cap visible on their head. They reach out with both hands to grasp and push the leafy stems toward the flames, shifting the heap relative to the concrete blocks. The fire continues to burn and the white smoke keeps rising and spreading against the house and fence. These background elements remain fixed while the person's handling of the branches provides the main visible motion.
